visual_action: A slideshow of three still photographs of Donald Trump. In the first, he wears an apron and waves from a drive-thru window. In the second, he wears an orange safety vest and sits in the driver's seat of a truck. In the third, he wears a hard hat on a construction site.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the sole subject of all three photographs shown in the video.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the @whitehouse account and features 'The WHITE HOUSE' text and logo on each image.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is accompanied only by music.
audio_music: A high-energy, bass-boosted, trap-style instrumental remix of 'The Star-Spangled Banner' plays consistently throughout the short video, creating a modern, patriotic, and hype-focused tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of three still images with basic cuts between them.
central_claim: The video portrays Donald Trump as a supporter of and participant in American labor, timed for Labor Day.
intended_effect: To foster a sense of patriotism and convey that Trump is aligned with and represents American workers.
